title: Robber targeting after correcting seating
source: Engine-arena cohorts under containment/robber-targeting and containment/robber-targeting-bias: the arm against the unchanged depth-2 control with an ETA and a fast builder, 64 deterministic seeds each played once per rotation (256 games per point).
